sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 2207 of 2025

Applicant :- Devendra Singh Urf Devinder
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- A.C.Srivastava,Subham Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Dheeraj Kumar Singh,G.A.
Hon'ble Chandra Dhari Singh,J.
1.

The instant bail application has been filed under Section 483 of BNSS, seeking bail in Case Crime No. 236 of 2023, under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 504 and 506 I.P.C., Police Station-Kavi Nagar, District-Ghaziabad 2.

Sri Pulak Ganguly, learned Advocate holding brief of Sri A.C.Srivastava, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant has submitted that the applicant is innocent person and has not committed any offence as alleged in the FIR.
He has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that similarly placed co-accused, Jatinder Urf Jitendra has already been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 11.02.2025 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.2596 of 2025 and, therefore, the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail on the ground of parity.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.2596 of 2025
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant is languishing in jail since 03.10.2024.
It is also undertaken on behalf of the applicant that he shall abide by all terms and conditions as imposed by the Court while granting bail.

3. Per contra, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State as well as learned counsel for the informant has vehemently opposed the instant bail application but they could not dispute the Devendra Singh Urf Devinder vs State Of U.P. on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102316510/
1 aforesaid facts as stated by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of applicant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Vijay Kumar Rathi, learned AGA, learned counsel for the informant and perused the material available on record.
5.

Taking into consideration the aforesaid reasons as stated above and the fact that similarly placed co-accused, Jatinder Urf Jitendra has already been granted bail by this Court, without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant-Devendra Singh Urf Devinder, who is involved in the aforementioned case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand)
and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
(i). The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence.

(ii) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on dates fixed for (1) opening of the case, (2) framing of charge and (3) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C./351 BNSS.

If in the opinion of the Trial Court absence of the applicant is deliberate of without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 9.5.2025 Anurag/-
(Chandra Dhari Singh,J.)
